system.description:
Art of Evasion: Make a Power Roll to maneuver the ship through difficult terrain or avoid obstacles. On a success the ship remains undamaged.

Dodge: Once per rest you can make a Reaction Roll against an incoming attack. On a success you negate the damage.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
